description: This file contains validation functions for scheduler cell configuration messages in a 5G NR context, including checks for PDCCH, RACH, PUSCH, PUCCH, SIB1, and paging configurations, as well as overall cell configuration validation.

methods.name: validate_pdcch_cfg_common
methods.description: Validates the PDCCH configuration within the scheduler cell configuration message, ensuring search spaces reference valid coreset IDs.

methods.name: validate_rach_cfg_common
methods.description: Validates RACH configuration parameters, including PRACH index, root sequence, and zero correlation zone, based on band and duplex mode.

methods.name: validade_pusch_td_res_list
methods.description: Checks that the PUSCH time domain resource list is sorted and within valid range, considering TDD configurations.

methods.name: validate_pusch_cfg_common
methods.description: Validates PUSCH configuration, specifically the resource list and its compliance with TDD patterns.

methods.name: validate_pucch_cfg_common
methods.description: Ensures PUCCH configuration is present in the message.

methods.name: validate_sib1_cfg
methods.description: Validates SIB1 transmission parameters, including MCS and payload size, based on the configuration and band.

methods.name: validate_paging_cfg
methods.description: Validates paging configuration parameters, especially the MCS index.

methods.name: validate_sched_cell_configuration_request_message
methods.description: Main validation function for scheduler cell configuration message, calling specific validation routines for each parameter.
